headline: ✅ **YOU SAT DOWN AT 5:23 AND CLEARED NINE CALLS OFF THIS BOARD IN SEVEN MINUTES — INCLUDING THE FOUR OLDEST THINGS ON IT.** Kim W.'s twenty-eight-day slab-leak request, Larry G.'s five-day-old reply, Greg E.'s review call overdue since March, and Patricia M.'s Fairhope valuation are all **closed**. ⭐ That is the nine-hour dark window being answered by hand, and this board was rebuilt at 5:40 so it would stop naming people you have already called. 🔍 **AND WHILE YOU WERE DOING IT, THE 21ST READ ON 355 COMANCHE LANDED AT 5:31 — a No, with a reason worth more than the No:** *the room listed downstairs as a bedroom has no closet.* **Four written reads on that house now, and all four left the price fields blank** — twenty-one showings, zero price objections, seven days to expiry. The 9/8 conversation is a **listing-accuracy** conversation, not a price cut. · **DO: call Mike H. — still the one card from this morning you have not touched** · **DECIDE: the Just Sold post — our 44 quiet days, or a straight celebration** · **WATCH: the card behind your business email declined again this morning.**

notes: ✅ **THE BEST NEWS ON THIS BOARD IS NOT MACHINE WORK — IT IS YOURS.** Between 5:23 and 5:30 PM you completed **nine** call-lane tasks, four of which had been sitting on this board for weeks. ⭐ The call lane now reads **45 open**, and it is 44 because you worked it, not because anything expired. ⚠️ One honest caveat: the 5:21 PM board published **60**, and 60 is not reproducible under either assignment scope tonight — nine of the gap is your completions and the rest is a measurement disagreement this desk has not settled. **Treat 44 as tonight's measured enumeration, not as proof of a sixteen-task drop.**

🔴 **NINE HOURS OF A WORKING TUESDAY WITH ZERO FLEET ACTIVITY — 8:0x AM to 5:05 PM.** The morning ran normally and on schedule, then simply stopped. ⭐ **THE SHAPE IS THE DIAGNOSIS:** routines do not run while the app is closed, so this is a machine-was-off gap, not a broken routine. The call sweep alone missed roughly eighteen turns. ✅ **MEASURED COST: zero leads.** The only lead in the window predates it and was already drafted.

🔌 **THE BRIVITY LANE IS BLOCKED AND THE SOCIAL LANE IS HALF-BLIND — one cause, one fix.** The 5:06 PM deep sweep logged BLOCKED: the Chrome extension reports no connected browser, and six of its seven parts run through it. The engagement run logged PARTIAL for the same reason — zero comments read across sixty-five posts. ⭐ Both fell back and validated the outage independently rather than reporting a clean board. ⚠️ A 5:24 PM check did see one live browser, so the pairing may be intermittent rather than dead.
